description: Test suite for session access and visibility management functions in the openclaw project, using Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines the visibility level for session tools, defaults to 'tree' if unset or invalid, accepts known values case-insensitively.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Calculates the effective session tools visibility considering sandbox mode and configured visibility settings.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines default sandbox session tools visibility clamp, defaulting to 'spawned'.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Provides context for sandboxed session tools, indicating restrictions and requester identities.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object governing cross-agent permissions based on configuration.

methods.name: createSessionVisibilityGuard
methods.description: Creates a guard object that enforces session visibility rules based on action, requester, and configuration.

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = createAgentToAgentPolicy({} as unknown as OpenClawConfig);$/
